Description

  • Funding Opportunity –Recovery Housing Program
     

    Application Deadline; Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis until funding is expended.
    Award Announcement: Applications will be reviewed every 60 days, with award decision to follow at nearest scheduled Community Development Advisory Committee meeting.
    CDFA Contact: Mollie Kaylor, Director of Housing and Community Development (mkaylor@nhcdfa.org / 603-717-9112)

    PRE-APPLICATION MEETING INFORMATION
    All RHP applicants are strongly encouraged to schedule a pre-application meeting with all involved parties and CDFA staff. Please contact Mollie Kaylor, Director of Housing and Community Development (mkaylor@nhcdfa.org / 603-717-9112).
    ABOUT THE RECOVERY HOUSING PROGRAM
    The Recovery Housing Program (RHP) awards funds to support community development projects that primarily benefit individuals in recovery for substance use disorder.
    Examples of eligible Housing and Public Facilities activities include:

    • Acquisition of real property
    • Rehabilitation and reconstruction of single-unit or multi-unit residential buildings
    • Rehabilitation and reconstruction of public facilities
    • New construction of housing

    Funding for RHP is provided to New Hampshire through the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development.
    RHP funding will be available for activities that will benefit individuals in recovery from substance use disorder. CDFA will prioritize projects that increase the number of beds serving individuals in recovery.
    All applications must be received by CDFA through its online grants management system (https://nhcdfagrants.org).
    Additional information on the Recovery Housing Program, including application information and resources, can be found by visiting: https://resources.nhcdfa.org/

    ELIGIBILITY GUIDELINES
    Eligible applicants for RHP funds include New Hampshire incorporated counties, cities, and towns. A nonprofit organization may also apply through its municipality or county as a sub-recipient of RHP funds. Eligible applicants may apply for up to $500,000 per subrecipient in RHP funds per program year.
    Please note the federally designated entitlement communities of Dover, Manchester, Nashua, Portsmouth, and Rochester are also eligible to apply for RHP funds through CDFA.
    Additional information on eligibility can be found in the RHP Application and Program Guide FINAL-CDFA-RHP-Application-and-Program-Guide-October-2022.pdf (nhcdfa.org)

    ADDITIONAL RESOURCES FOR APPLICANTS
    The following resources are available to assist applicants:

    • RHP Application and Program Guide
    • How to Register for CDFA's Grant Management System (GMS)
    • Tips for Using CDFA's Grant Management System (GMS)

    ABOUT THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT FINANCE AUTHORITY
    The Community Development Finance Authority (CDFA) is a statewide nonprofit public authority focused on maximizing the value and impact of community development, economic development and clean energy initiatives throughout New Hampshire. The organization leverages a variety of financial and technical resources, including the competitive deployment of grant, loan and equity programs.
    To learn more about CDFA, its impact on New Hampshire communities, and available funding resources, visit www.nhcdfa.org or call 603-226-2170.
